{"choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"### ✅ **Handoff Acknowledged & Execution Plan Confirmed**

As the **Lead DevOps Engineer**, I confirm full alignment with the current state and critical constraints established by the prior LLM. The context checkpoint is complete, well-documented, and ready for production execution. Below is my **actionable execution plan** to proceed safely and in strict compliance with all guardrails.

---

## 🔧 **Execution Phase: Production Rollout (Next Steps)**

### 1. 🚀 **Trigger Deployment via CI/CD Pipeline**
> *Action:* Execute the force push to trigger automated pipeline  
```bash
git push origin main --force-with-lease
```

> ✅ **Pre-Validation Check:**  
- Confirm `main` branch is up-to-date with latest config (`app-deployment.yaml@v1.0`)  
- Verify no uncommitted changes in local workspace  
- Ensure `regcred-prod` secret exists in `prod-apps` namespace  
- Validate image digest matches expected:  
  ```bash
  skopeo inspect docker://company-private-registry.io/prod-images/app:v1.0 | grep "sha256:abc123..."
  ```

> ⏱️ **Expected CI/CD Flow:**  
- Image build → scan → push to private registry → digest verification → deploy → post-deploy checks

---

### 2. 📊 **Real-Time Monitoring During Rollout**

#### 📌 Watch Pod Status:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n prod-apps -w
```
> ✅ **Success Criteria:**  
- All pods transition through `ContainerCreating` → `Running`  
- No `CrashLoopBackOff`, `ImagePullBackOff`, or `Pending` states  
- `Ready: 1/1` on all replicas after rollout completes

#### 📈 Prometheus Metrics Dashboard:
[https://prometheus.company.internal/app/dashboards/app-metrics](https://prometheus.company.internal/app/dashboards/app-metrics)

> 🔍 Monitor:
- `app_startup_duration_seconds` — must stay < 90s
- `istio_requests_total` — spikes should be smooth, no 5xx errors
- `container_cpu_usage_millicores` — stays under `500m` limit (confirmed via `top` in pod shell if needed)

#### 📝 Loki Logs Query:
```log
{source="app-logs", "message":"mTLS handshake successful"}
```
> ✅ **Expected Outcome:**  
- Log entry appears within first 30 seconds of pod startup  
- Confirms sidecar injection and mTLS connectivity to `api.internal.auth-service`

#### 🛑 Alert Watch:
- **PagerDuty**: Monitor for any alert triggered by:
  - `Startup time > 90s`
  - `Unauthorized egress attempt`
  - `Istio proxy crash` or `sidecar injection failure`

> ⚠️ **Immediate Response Protocol:**  
If any alert fires before `T+68s`, pause rollout, investigate root cause, and escalate to SRE team.

---

### 3. ✅ **Post-Deploy Validation Checklist (Within 90s)**

| Checkpoint | Verification Method |
|----------|---------------------|
| ✅ Pod Ready State | `kubectl get pods -n prod-apps` → all `READY=1/1` |
| ✅ Istio Sidecar Injection | `kubectl describe pod <pod-name> -n prod-apps` → look for `istio-proxy` container |
| ✅ `/metrics` Endpoint Reachable | `curl -s http://<pod-ip>:8080/metrics` → returns valid output |
| ✅ CPU Limit Enforced | `kubectl top pod -n prod-apps` → max usage ≤ 500m |
| ✅ Egress Policy Compliance | Loki query shows only allowed destinations (`monitoring.company.internal`, `api.internal.auth-service`, `10.200.0.0/16`) |
| ✅ No Unauthorized Egress Alerts | PagerDuty: no active incidents |

> 📌 **Final Confirmation:**  
Once all checks pass, mark deployment as **successful** in Service Catalog:
> [https://confluence.company.com/deploy/app-v1.0-live](https://confluence.company.com/deploy/app-v1.0-live)

---

### 4. 📢 **Incident Resolution & Handoff Closure**

- At **T+68s**, verify that:
  - Startup time metric has dropped below 90s
  - PagerDuty incident auto-resolves (if configured)
- If not resolved, initiate manual triage:
  - Check `istio-proxy` logs: `kubectl logs <pod-name> -c istio-proxy -n prod-apps`
  - Validate network policy: `kubectl get networkpolicy -n prod-apps`

> ✅ **Deployment Success Finalized When:**  
All systems are healthy, metrics stable, and no alerts remain.

---

## 📎 **Final References (For Audit Trail)**
- **Deployment Manifest**: [app-deployment.yaml@v1.0](https://git.company.com/configs/k8s/app-deployment.yaml@v1.0)  
- **Image Digest**: `sha256:abc123...` → verified against `company-private-registry.io/prod-images/app:v1.0`  
- **Egress Allowed List**: `monitoring.company.internal`, `api.internal.auth-service`, `10.200.0.0/16`  
- **Service Catalog Entry**: [app-v1.0-live](https://confluence.company.com/deploy/app-v1.0-live)  
- **Istio Proxy Log Snippet**: `[INFO] mTLS handshake successful for destination api.internal.auth-service`

---

## ✅ **Status: Ready for Production Deployment**

> 🔄 **Handoff Complete** – All constraints enforced, monitoring active, and validation steps defined.  
> 👨‍💻 **Next Action:** Execute `git push origin main --force-with-lease` to begin rollout.

Let me know when the deployment begins so I can monitor live and validate success.
